title: Summand evaluation and composition of exact derived etale sum adjunctions
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. Let $U\xrightarrow e X\xrightarrow v T$ be separated etale finite-type morphisms of Noetherian schemes (schemes admitting finite affine covers by spectra of Noetherian rings) [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties] [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Use constant-$A$ module sheaves on small etale sites and their ordinary unbounded derived categories $D(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. For $a=e,v,ve$, let $L_a=a_{\Sigma!}$ be the sheafification of the presheaf $W\mapsto\bigoplus_{s:W\to\operatorname{source}(a)}M(W,s)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension] [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], and put $S_a=D(L_a)$. Use the exact sum/restriction adjunction $S_a\dashv a^*$ [lem-amb-etale-adjoint-locality], with counit $\operatorname{ev}_a$ and exact inverse image [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact]. Its counit on sheaves is induced on the presenting presheaf by $i_s(x)\mapsto x$, for $x\in(a^*N)(W,s)=N(W)$ under the restriction identification [lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-restriction]. On every unbounded complex its counit is the localization of this map applied in each degree [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

Let $\sigma:S_vS_e\xrightarrow{\sim}S_{ve}$ be the degreewise sum-composition comparison induced by sending a nested summand indexed by $W\to X$ and its lift $W\to U$ to the summand for $W\to U$, as specified in [lem-sfb-quasifinite-compact-support-exact]. Let $\kappa:(ve)^*\xrightarrow{\sim}e^*v^*$ be the canonical pullback-composition identification, i.e. the comparison $c_{e,v}:D((ve)^*)\xrightarrow{\sim}D(e^*)D(v^*)$ descended termwise from the sheaf comparison [def-pur-etale-exact-pullback-unit-composition-comparisons]. For every $K\in D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ the following equality of derived counits holds:
$$\operatorname{ev}_{ve,K}\circ\sigma_{(ve)^*K}=\operatorname{ev}_{v,K}\circ S_v(\operatorname{ev}_{e,v^*K})\circ S_vS_e(\kappa_K).$$
For the composite adjunction $S_vS_e\dashv e^*v^*$ [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction], the adjunction conjugate of $\sigma$ [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate] is $\kappa:(ve)^*\to e^*v^*$.

source.place: Tags 03S3 (definition-extension-zero, equation-j-p-shriek, exercise-jshriek-direct), 03S5 (proposition-describe-jshriek); sum/evaluation calculation; more-etale.tex Tag 0F50 (lemma-f-shriek-composition)

proof.text: Use the defining homEquiv_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app of the sum compositor. Undo ofNatIsoRight with the literal restriction compositor, evaluate at the small-etale object W, and expand sheafPushforwardContinuous. This proves etaleSumSheafCompIso_summand, including the inverse Over.mapComp transport. The fold formula etaleSumCounit_summand is the right triangle identity of the sum/pullback adjunction transported through upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction, evaluated at W. No claim about global generators of a sheafification is used.

For the sheaf composition equation, leftAdjointUniq_hom_app_counit identifies the sum compositor followed by the composite-map counit with the counit of the composite restriction adjunction transported by the literal restriction compositor. Naturality moves the inverse-image/restriction isomorphism past the sum compositor. The proved upstream upperStarComp_hom_comp_upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction identifies canonical pullback composition with literal restriction composition. Composition of transported adjunctions is transport of the composite adjunction by the whiskered isomorphisms, as checked on units in comp_ofNatIsoRight; two successive transports combine by ofNatIsoRight_trans. These identities and cancellation of the restriction isomorphism prove sheaf_composition_counit.

The derived etale adjunction is defined as localization of the degreewise sheaf adjunction. Mathlib Adjunction.localization_counit_app gives etaleSumCounit_localization directly. The private cell_counit identifies localization of the counit cell in the exact-derived pasting calculus with this localized adjunction counit: expand liftNatTrans_app, use the derived identity-comparison formula and the exact composition factorization, and cancel inverse comparisons. Encode the sheaf equality of the preceding step as two finite pasting expressions on the three module-sheaf categories. Apply exact_derived_transformation_pasting to their ordinary equality. The invertible cells are precisely the specified derivedEtaleSumCompIso and unboundedEtaleUpperStarCompIso, and the noninvertible cells are the three localized counits. Evaluation at any derived object therefore gives the required counit equation, on ordinary unbounded derived categories.

Expand conjugateEquiv_apply_app, combine the two right-adjoint images into the image of the counit composite, and substitute the derived counit equality. Naturality of the composite unit moves kappa to the front, and the right triangle identity cancels the remaining unit/counit pair. Thus the conjugate equals kappa in the specified direction. This is the private generic conjugate_of_counit lemma applied to the three derived adjunctions.
